hints.title: Fluent Method Chaining Interface
hints.text: Enabling fluent operation sequences requires each arithmetic method to update an internal accumulator and return the instance reference.

hints.title: Method Return this Pattern
hints.text: Return this from add, subtract, multiply, divide, and power. Throw an error on division by zero.

hints.title: Calculator Blueprint
hints.text: Store this.val = value. add(v): this.val += v; return this. subtract(v): this.val -= v; return this. multiply(v): this.val *= v; return this. divide(v): if (v === 0) throw new Error("Division by zero is not allowed"); this.val /= v; return this. power(v): this.val **= v; return this. getResult(): return this.val.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: All chained arithmetic methods execute in constant time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Returning the numeric value instead of this prevents method chaining.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Accumulator state resides in single instance field.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Defensive exception throwing when dividing by zero.

solutions.approach: Fluent Method Chaining Object with Zero-Division Guard
